segments.name: Lindblad
segments.description: Runs expedition cruises on its vessels.
segments.evidence: Segments Lindblad Segment The Lindblad segment consists primarily of ship-based expeditions aboard customized, nimble and intimately-scaled vessels that are designed for discovery, enabling us to venture where larger cruise ships cannot, thereby allowing Lindblad to offer up-close experiences in the planet's wild and remote places and capitals of culture.
